title: 谁在收藏声音
prompt:

Use every input according to its explicitly labelled role; preserve existing named identities, not just species. Input 1: canonical identity reference for 皮皮 (pipi); preserve this character exactly. Input 2: Pipi clothing sheet only; follow the exact outfit specified below. Input 3: canonical identity reference for 团团 (tuantuan); preserve this character exactly. Input 4: canonical identity reference for 芽芽 (yaya); preserve this character exactly.

Standing body-height ratios (not ear or tail tips): 皮皮 1.0, 团团 0.9. Pipi wears ONLY the LEFT daytime outfit from the wardrobe sheet: dusty blue overalls, oatmeal shirt, blue cloth shoes, small yellow backpack. No star cap in daytime. Tuantuan wears the short dark ochre/rust scarf. Yaya wears a soft muted green scarf.  Scene continuity: 森林学堂的秋日窗边，软金色斜阳。
The SINGLE visual moment and framing: 皮皮、团团、芽芽一起侧耳听秋风与落叶；皮皮带着好奇望向两位朋友。
Emotional performance for this exact beat: 三位小伙伴神情轻快专注，彼此自然互动。

Style: hand-painted gentle watercolor on fine warm paper, muted natural hues, soft edges and rounded shapes, quiet storybook mood, no glossy 3D or photorealism. Daylight scenes use soft greens and warm daylight, not bedroom amber tint. Night scenes use soft warm lamplight and muted gray-blue windows. Composition: full-bleed vertical 9:16. Keep all important faces, hands, feet, biscuits, fabric folds and other story actions in the upper 68% of the image. Bottom 32% is low-detail negative space for later subtitles, with no crucial objects there. Make the specified story state visually understandable. Text: NONE. No words, labels, subtitles, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, panels, frames or collage. Do not reproduce model sheets, multiple versions of a character, or wardrobe lineups. Each named character appears exactly once. This is a new single coherent scene, not a copy of the references. No motion streaks or implied camera zoom. Never turn a metaphor into a real transformation: yellow blankets remain fabric, imagined grassy softness is not actual grass growing in bed. No new story events. Continuity-specific locks: Do not show the wooden memory box in the school or outdoor memory scenes. Do not depict sound as visible letters, music notes, sound waves, glowing objects, or captured material. Reference roles: Input 1 is the canonical identity reference for pipi; preserve this exact character. Input 2 shows Pipi's day and sleep outfits; use only the outfit specified in the prompt. Input 3 is the canonical identity reference for tuantuan; preserve this exact character. Input 4 is the canonical identity reference for yaya; preserve this exact character.
